title: Choose Your Lenses: Flaws in Gender Bias Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates gender bias by comparing intrinsic metrics (measuring bias in internal model representations, such as WEAT and compression rates) with extrinsic metrics (measuring performance differences on downstream tasks like occupation prediction and coreference resolution). It uses datasets such as Bias in Bios and Winobias to analyze the correlation between these metric types and the impact of dataset composition.
